{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
dup_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

df_duplicates = df[duplicate_patients]

# Check the sample_seq for duplicates
df_duplicates_sorted = df_duplicates.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Show the highest sample_seq per patient
df_max_seq = df_duplicates_sorted.groupby('patient_id').first()

# Count how many patients have duplicates
num_retested = len(df_max_seq)

# Print results
dup_count, num_retested, df_max_seq.head(3)"}
